M8.what: ELIGIBLE ticks (disastersEnabled && pop > 200 at the roll) per 14,400-tick soak
M8.detail: 17 of 20 seeds spent 14,388-14,396 of 14,400 ticks eligible. Seed 10 COLLAPSED to pop 0 (3,019 eligible, 79% ineligible), seed 30 collapsed late (7,897), seed 28 ran thin (9,755). The eligible-tick denominator is load-bearing, not cosmetic: dividing by calendar years would under-report the rate by 8% and fail correct code.

M9.detail: the abort at `if (!front.length) return` spends ZERO hazard draws and does NOT re-roll — which is exactly why the other six rows must NOT be renormalised when the flood row publishes 0.

M10.what: newsQueue drain under the live rAF loop (push 20, wait ~36 frames)
M10.detail: newsQueue is a CONSUMED queue, so any gate that counts RESIDENTS can never reach 20. C11 must count push CALLS via an instrumented wrapper.
M10.source: design brief M10 (browser measurement; this pass ran headless and could not re-measure it)

M11.what: minimap canvas hash at cam.r 0/1/2/3, CENTRED camera, mode 'value'

M12.detail: the viewport rect in renderMinimap routes 4 screen corners through the rotation-aware screenToTileF, so hashing the CANVAS across cam.r is an invalid rotation test and would fail correct code. C13 hashes the module-scope riskBuf band buffer instead.

M13.what: cost of the new read paths
M13.detail: The node vm harness runs identical scalar arithmetic 19.3x slower than plain node (hzResp over 6400 tiles: 1.16 ms in-vm vs 0.06 ms plain), so the in-browser full-map band bake is ~0.4 ms, against the design brief's measured renderMinimap('value') cost of 3.047 ms. The bake is memoised in render.js module scope on (devRev, terrRev, powerEpoch, trafficEpoch, tickCount/14, funding.fire, funding.police, disastersEnabled, year), so a repaint that changes nothing costs one string compare.

M14.value: mean fireCov over zoned tiles 2.53 -> 0 at tick 8 (recomputeMaps period 14)
M14.source: design brief M14; the /14 term in the render memo key is taken from it

calibration_identity.note: C3 is an ARITHMETIC IDENTITY, not a soak. Verified in this pass on FX-REF and on a blank city.
calibration_identity.neutral_anchor_exp: 1.000000000000 on ALL SEVEN rows, delta exactly 0
calibration_identity.neutral_anchor_state: a BLANK city in a non-summer, non-spring month sits on every documented anchor by construction: hazardCensus defaults covFire/covPol to SVC_OK, pollLocal to POLL_BAD/2, crimeLocal to CRIME_BAD/2, lowShare to 0.35, denseShare to 0.25, frontShare to 0 and agedShare/unempShare to 0, and svcStrain starts at 1.

bands.zero_point: exp 1.000 (every driver on its neutral anchor) lands in ELEVATED. The ruler's neutral is a COMPETENTLY RUN city, not a risk-free one; LOW is reserved for cities measurably better than the anchor.
bands.one_definition: HAZARD_BANDS is declared once in js/sim.js and read by hazardBand(), which the Risk minimap, the FIRE_RISK_HIGH advisory row and the panel chip all go through.

ruler_definition.response_curve: hzResp(v, anchor, bad) = clamp(0, 2, 1 + (v - anchor)/(bad - anchor)) — exactly 1.000 at the neutral anchor, exactly 2.000 at the bad anchor. Direction is carried by the anchor pair, never a sign flag.
ruler_definition.weight_invariant: Inside any one row, w_max < 2 * w_min. A driver on its bad anchor scores 2w while every neutral driver scores 1w, so this is exactly the condition under which a SINGLE-CAUSE city is guaranteed to name the driver that moved. Verified: fire (5,3,3,3), riot (5,4,4,3), tornado (3,2), and four single-driver rows.
ruler_definition.contrib: driver share of the row's OWN score, dimensionless, summing to 1 per row. The named-contributor argmax runs on contrib and NEVER on the raw val (0..255 coverage / shares / seasons are incommensurable). Ties break by ascending driver id.

drivers: anchor 1, bad 2 -> exp pinned at 1.000 forever
developed share of the coast front

tile_score.compound_severe: the SEVERE band is unreachable unless fireCov < SVC_LOW (40) AND (lvl >= 2 OR an aged plant sits inside the 5x5 stamp). Everything else is held one hair under the top edge. That is what makes FIRE_RISK_HIGH strictly NARROWER than the shipped FIRE_THIN row rather than a second copy of it.

palette.note: SEVERE is deliberately NOT gold — the land-value ramp already owns #ffe066 at its top, and a mayor switching between 'value' and 'risk' must never read 'prime real estate' as 'about to burn'.

notes_for_the_verifier: The panel publishes TWO quantities per row and says so on the face of it. ODDS are a pure function of the shipped spawn model and are city-invariant; BANDS are exposure. Any gate that expects the published odds to move with coverage is testing a lie GP8a deliberately refuses to tell.

GP8a adds ZERO fields to City and ZERO keys to the save. The Risk band buffer lives in js/render.js MODULE scope (riskBuf / riskKey), which is what makes the read-only proof structural rather than argued.

hazardReport() calls hazardCensus() exactly ONCE and deptStrain() ZERO times — the strain figures are read off city.svcStrain, which recomputeMaps already derives from one deptStrain census every 14 ticks. Re-running it would be a second computation of a published number.
The soak in this artifact is 20 seeds x 50 years = 921 ELIGIBLE city-years, not the design's 10 x 50. The larger sample still leaves six of seven kinds under the power floor.
